name: spock-test-runner-vscode-tr
description: Run, debug, and measure code coverage of Spock Framework (Groovy) tests using Gradle or Maven, with native VS Code Test Explorer integration
copyright: Copyright 2025 Lukas Zaruba, Copyright 2026 Tomasz Rup
author: Tomasz Rup

untrustedWorkspaces.description: This extension executes build tools (Gradle/Maven) and cannot operate safely in untrusted workspaces.

spockTestRunner.debugPort.description: Port number used by the JVM debug agent (JDWP). Used for both Gradle and Maven debug sessions.

spockTestRunner.testTimeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for each spawned test process (batch run) before killing it.

spockTestRunner.debugConnectionTimeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for the JVM debug port to become available before giving up.

spockTestRunner.debugRetries.description: Number of times to retry attaching the debugger if the initial connection fails.

spockTestRunner.additionalGradleArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to every Gradle invocation (e.g. ["-Dkey=value", "--no-daemon"]).

spockTestRunner.additionalMavenArgs.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to every Maven invocation (e.g. ["-Dkey=value", "-o"]).

spockTestRunner.showDiffView.description: (Preview) When enabled, failed assertions show expected/actual values in VS Code's inline diff view. Disable to show plain error messages instead.

spockTestRunner.testSourcePatterns.description: Glob patterns used to discover Spock test files. Add entries for custom source sets (e.g. "**/src/integrationTest/groovy/**/*.groovy").
